p.src: 1  God presides in the great assembly. He judges among the gods.

en: God presides in the great assembly. He judges among the gods.
u.src: 1  God presides in the great assembly. He judges among the gods.

p.src: 2  “How long will you judge unjustly, and show partiality to the wicked?” Selah.

en: “How long will you judge unjustly, and show partiality to the wicked?” Selah.
u.src: 2  “How long will you judge unjustly, and show partiality to the wicked?” Selah.

p.src: 3  “Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless. Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.

en: “Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless. Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.
u.src: 3  “Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless. Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.

p.src: 4  Rescue the weak and needy. Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.”

en: Rescue the weak and needy. Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.”
u.src: 4  Rescue the weak and needy. Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.”

p.src: 5  They don’t know, neither do they understand. They walk back and forth in darkness. All the foundations of the earth are shaken.

en: They don’t know, neither do they understand. They walk back and forth in darkness. All the foundations of the earth are shaken.
u.src: 5  They don’t know, neither do they understand. They walk back and forth in darkness. All the foundations of the earth are shaken.

p.src: 6  I said, “You are gods, all of you are sons of the Most High.

en: I said, “You are gods, all of you are sons of the Most High.
u.src: 6  I said, “You are gods, all of you are sons of the Most High.

p.src: 7  Nevertheless you shall die like men, and fall like one of the rulers.”

en: Nevertheless you shall die like men, and fall like one of the rulers.”
u.src: 7  Nevertheless you shall die like men, and fall like one of the rulers.”

p.src: 8  Arise, God, judge the earth, for you inherit all of the nations.

en: Arise, God, judge the earth, for you inherit all of the nations.
u.src: 8  Arise, God, judge the earth, for you inherit all of the nations.
